problem.title: Installing Anaconda on Windows 10: Something went wrong during the installation, and conda cannot be found
problem.description: I'm trying to install Anaconda on a Windows 10 laptop at work. For some reason, the installation always fails: I can see the Anaconda prompt, but no trace of Anaconda Navigator, Spyder, etc. Every time I type where conda in the command prompt or the Anaconda prompt I always get the following message: INFO: Could not find files for the given pattern(s). And every time I try to use a conda command, I get: 'conda' is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file.
